title: Fix flash-agent CLI: exit code 1, MCP transport not connecting (0613-0617 follow-up)
description:
Agent bridge E2E tests added by tasks 0613-0617 are failing. 6 tests fail with exit code 1 (flash-agent CLI not connecting to MCP server). 2 tests fail because docId is undefined in document summary response.

Root cause areas to investigate:
1. flash-agent CLI (packages/ or apps/): why does it return exit code 1 instead of 0?
2. MCP /mcp endpoint: is it being served by the Vite dev server during E2E tests?
3. document summary resource: why is docId missing from the response?

Key test file: apps/desktop/e2e/agent-mcp.spec.ts
Key impl files: check packages/ and apps/desktop/src/ for 'mcp', 'flash-agent', 'editor_status', 'doc_summary'

Run: pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e --grep 'flash-agent|MCP agent' 2>&1 | tail -40

All 8 agent-mcp/flash-agent tests must pass.
